lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀在花丛间穿行。
lines.en: I beat my wings through the flower beds.

lines.zh: 我的花纹在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: My pattern shines in the sunlight.
I skim along the edge of the hive.
Wings humming, I sweep past a honey drop.

lines.zh: 我跟着普通蜜蜂走同一条路。
lines.en: I follow the same route as the ordinary bees.

lines.zh: 花粉沾在我腿上，沉甸甸。
lines.en: Pollen clings heavily to my legs.
I circle a stamen and fly deeper in.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上一跳一跳。
lines.en: My shadow bounces along the ground.

lines.zh: 我和同伴排成一列飞行。
lines.en: My kin and I fly in a single line.

lines.zh: 这身花纹今天特别显眼。
lines.en: This pattern of mine stands out today.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，换了个方向。
lines.en: I hover, then pick a new direction.
My wings beat fast but my path wanders.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙缝找下一朵花。
lines.en: I follow a wall crack to the next flower.
I dip low when passing the hive.

lines.zh: 我抄近路穿过两堵蜡墙之间。
lines.en: I cut between two walls of wax.

lines.zh: 一滴蜂蜜挂在半空，我绕过去。
lines.en: A drop of honey hangs in the air. I fly around it.
I hang by the hive and groom my wings.

lines.zh: 触角互相碰一下，打招呼。
lines.en: We touch antennae in greeting.

lines.zh: 我又换了一身颜色的花纹。
lines.en: I have just changed to another color pattern.
This drop of honey will last me a while.

lines.zh: 我和旁边的蜜蜂挤在一起。
lines.en: I squeeze in beside the bee next to me.

lines.zh: 翅膜上的纹路我数不清。
lines.en: I cannot count the veins in my wings.
I am waiting for a signal from the hive.
The smell of pollen makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我把腿上的花粉梳下来。
lines.en: I comb the pollen off my legs.

lines.zh: 普通蜜蜂从我身边飞过。
lines.en: Plain bees fly past me one after another.

lines.zh: 这一身花纹，是娘胎里带的。
lines.en: This pattern came with me from the egg.
Today's flowers smell sweeter than yesterday's.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的花纹看什么。
lines.en: What are you staring at my pattern for?

lines.zh: 我停在你面前的叶子上。
lines.en: I land on the leaf in front of you.

lines.zh: 你的帽子颜色和我的花纹撞了。
lines.en: Your hat color clashes with my pattern.

lines.zh: 在你头顶绕了一圈，看见了。
lines.en: One loop overhead, and I saw you.
You reach out, so I rise a little.
I recognize the smoke smell on you.
You are leaning your face too close.
I am looking at the flower in your hand.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的工夫我换了位置。
lines.en: In the blink of an eye I have moved.
Do not swat; I am not going to bite.
There is a tear in my wing membrane.
I lost a few tufts of fuzz.
My pattern isn't even settled yet.
I shake myself and fly again.
The whole swarm saw you hit me.
My wings buzz at a different pitch now.
A mark has appeared across my pattern.
It hurts, but I will come back.
I drop to the ground and climb up again.
You have roused the entire hive.
Is that flower meant for me?
I smell something sweet in your hand.
You hold up a flower, so I circle twice.
Not this one; I want an open bloom.

lines.zh: 我落在你的指节上闻了闻。
lines.en: I land on your knuckle and sniff.

lines.zh: 甜的东西我一向不拒绝。
lines.en: I never turn down anything sweet.
The nectar in your hand is glistening.
I follow you for three short hops.
Hold still; I cannot judge the landing spot.
I am definitely tasting this.

lines.zh: 你撞飞了我，翅膜还在响。
lines.en: You knocked me flying; my wings still buzz.
I bounce right off your shoulder.
Do not stand in the hive entrance.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子了，蜂群会知道。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; the hive will know.
I hit your hat brim and I am dazed.

lines.zh: 我们同时往一边躲，撞上了。
lines.en: We dodged the same way and collided.
My wing brushed your face; sorry.
You are blocking my way back to the hive.
I skimmed right past you.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得转了半圈。
lines.en: That bump spun me half a turn.
My pattern will pass to my young.
I can pair with ordinary bees too.
Whichever they resemble is down to luck.
I circle my partner once in the air.
These colors came from my parents.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会换一种花纹。
lines.en: Our young will wear a different pattern.

lines.zh: 巢里又要多几张新翅膜。
lines.en: Soon the hive will have more new wings.
I wait for her to come back from the flowers.

lines.zh: 花粉和花纹一起传下去。
lines.en: Pollen and pattern pass down together.

lines.zh: 我们的花纹会传给孩子。
lines.en: Our patterns will pass to the brood.
That grain of pollen is mine.
A piece of honeycomb fell at the entrance.
I gather it up with my front legs.
A fallen flower on the ground; I take it.
Even this small piece makes a meal.
I carry it in my jaws back to the hive.
Nothing dropped goes to waste.
I am taking the seed you dropped.
This pollen ball is heavy; I rest a moment.
This bit of honey debris is mine.
You poked the hive; I remember.
The whole swarm is watching you.
I turn around and fly at you.
You move exactly like a honey thief.
I have fixed on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你手里那块蜜脾是我们的。
lines.en: That honeycomb in your hand is ours.
Attention all: someone is here.
I do not like the sound of your steps.
You crushed part of the hive entrance.
The target is you; do not run.
I circle around you in the air.
I dive the moment you raise a hand.
The swarm has already surrounded you.
I fly right beside your ear.
Your neck is exposed.

lines.zh: 这一身花纹，你觉得眼熟吗？
lines.en: Does this pattern look familiar to you?
I am waiting for the best angle.
My stinger is ready.
Wherever you retreat, I follow.
The circle keeps shrinking.
My stinger sinks into your wrist.
I smack into the bridge of your nose.
The swarm rushes in together.
This hit comes sticky with honey.
You swat air; I am behind you.
The sting leaves a small red mark.
I loop around and sting again.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，蜂群追得更快。
lines.en: You run, and the swarm chases faster.
The sting will make you remember today.
We are not one; we are a swarm.

lines.zh: 我从蜂巢的蜡缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out through a crack in the wax.
This flower field is room enough for us.
A brand new pattern, just grown in.

lines.zh: 普通蜜蜂在巢口迎接我。
lines.en: Plain bees greet me at the entrance.
The smell of honey wakes me from sleep.
I was born in the Bumblezone.
My wings are still soft; I test them first.
The hive is already packed with kin.

lines.zh: 蜂后不会在意多我一个。
lines.en: The queen will not mind one more of me.
This flower field is room enough for us.
The flame singed my wings.
I drop out of the air into the grass.
I fall in the water and my wings sink.
Even the hive walls are rattling.
An arrow grazes my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀突然不听使唤。
lines.en: My wings suddenly stop obeying me.
Three days without nectar and I cannot fly.
The thunderclap drops me a few feet.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走了我翅上的暖。
lines.en: The void drains the warmth from my wings.
